nodes.label: Agent Instructions
nodes.rationale: Documents key compatibility fixes: app.py changed from on_startup to lifespan pattern (starlette 1.x compat), es/es.py prepends http:// scheme for ES 8.x, db_init.py replaced get_event_loop with asyncio.run (Python 3.14 compat). Also documents dev environment as systemd services with PostgreSQL Docker container.

nodes.label: QuantumPACS Project
nodes.rationale: Open-source PACS for medical image management. Replaces vendor-locked systems with open architecture. Backend: Starlette, asyncpg, JWT, Alembic, pluggable storage (FS, S3, B2). Frontend: React SPA, Ant Design 6, Cornerstone3D 5. Database: PostgreSQL 16 with LISTEN/NOTIFY replication triggers.

nodes.label: Sprint 0: Foundation
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Eliminate all trivial single-file bugs. 7 parallel tracks: config-logging, db-connection, dicom-server, storage, websocket, code-quality, lifecycle-exceptions. No schema changes.

nodes.label: Sprint 1: Schema Migration
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Database schema hardening. 8 sequential steps: Alembic migration 006, UNIQUE(username), FK indexes, PK on replica_files, UNIQUE on shared_files(hash), indexes on patients(name)/logs(created), nullable file_changes.by_user_id, pre-migration dedup script.

nodes.label: Sprint 2: Data Integrity
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Fix all data-loss and race-condition bugs. 5 parallel tracks: files-core, replica-sync, users-auth, patient-study-series, share-file-changes. Critical path: C01 ES atomicity.

nodes.label: Sprint 3: Auth & Security
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Eliminate all authentication and authorization vulnerabilities. 3 parallel tracks: auth-hardening, rate-limiting, schema-validation. Invokes security-fastapi sub-skill.

nodes.label: Sprint 4: Performance & Scalability
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Fix all OOM risks, blocking patterns, and scaling bottlenecks. 3 parallel tracks: pool-tuning, storage-streaming, sync-engine.

nodes.label: Sprint 5: Observability
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Make the system observable in production. 4 sequential steps: JSON logging formatter, request_id middleware, Prometheus metrics, component-level health check.

nodes.label: Sprint 6: Testing
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Eliminate flaky tests, add real integration test coverage. 4 parallel tracks: fix-flakes, integration-infra (conftest + test DB fixture), integration-tests (11 DB tables), load-tests (k6/locust).

nodes.label: Sprint 7: Redis Features
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Horizontally-scalable WebSocket state via Redis pub/sub. 4 sequential steps: add redis dep, RedisPubSub channel-per-file manager, replace module-level dict, keep in-memory local cache.

nodes.label: Sprint 8: Frontend Hardening
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Secure the frontend and improve UX under production load. 5 parallel tracks: login (CAPTCHA/progressive delay), auth-storage (httpOnly cookies), sidebar (fix PAGINATION.limit), retry (useFetch), perf (progressive loading + code splitting).

nodes.label: Backend Core Agent Role
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Targets: config.py, log.py, exceptions.py, lifecycle.py, app.py, api/schemas/*.py
